input.raw_text: URGENT HEALTH ADVISORY: Drinking a mixture of warm water, squeezed lemon, and 1 teaspoon of baking soda every morning alkalizes your blood pH and kills 100% of cancer cells within 48 hours. Big Pharma is hiding this simple cure! Forward to all groups to save lives.

claim: Drinking warm lemon water with baking soda alkalizes blood pH and eradicates 100% of cancer cells in 48 hours.

confidence.rationale: Medical physiology confirms human blood pH is strictly regulated by the kidneys and lungs (7.35-7.45); oral intake cannot alter systemic blood pH to cure oncology diseases.

plain_explanation: This viral health claim is completely false and dangerous. The human body tightly regulates blood pH between 7.35 and 7.45 regardless of food or drink consumed. There is zero scientific or clinical evidence that lemon and baking soda eliminate cancer cells, and delaying evidence-based oncology care for homemade remedies causes severe harm.

evidence.excerpt: There is no scientific basis to claim an alkaline diet or consuming sodium bicarbonate neutralizes or cures cancer in humans. Dietary changes cannot alter systemic blood pH.
Consuming lemon, sodium bicarbonate, or acidic/alkaline remedies has not been shown to treat internal chronic pathologies or metabolic malignancies.

counter_arguments_checked: Do in-vitro laboratory studies show cancer cells struggle in alkaline cell culture dishes?
Can high doses of sodium bicarbonate cause electrolyte imbalances?
edge_cases_identified: In-vitro cell petri dish tests showing cellular pH sensitivity do not translate to living human anatomy, because stomach acid immediately neutralizes ingested sodium bicarbonate and kidneys maintain homeostasis.
stress_test.robustness_summary: Extensive peer-reviewed oncology literature universally disproves that dietary alkalinity destroys tumors in human physiology.

truth_timeline.event: Earliest known variations of the 'lemon + bicarbonate 10,000x stronger than chemotherapy' chain email originated on online forums.
truth_timeline.significance: Traces the pseudo-medical origin of the myth.

truth_timeline.event: Peer-reviewed systematic reviews in BMJ Open evaluated alkaline diets and confirmed lack of therapeutic efficacy in oncology.
truth_timeline.significance: Rigorous medical confirmation refuting the claim.

truth_timeline.event: Ongoing global health fact-checks consistently rate this claim as completely debunked.
truth_timeline.significance: Demonstrates persistent zombie misinformation requiring proactive flagging.

action_risk.warning_flag: DANGEROUS: Do not substitute medically prescribed cancer therapy with home remedies.
action_risk.recommended_action: Do not forward this message. Consult a licensed physician or oncologist for medical guidance. Excessive baking soda consumption can lead to metabolic alkalosis and kidney strain.
